title: Heights and Distances Problems — Some Applications of Trigonometry
hook: Let's explore Heights and Distances Problems from the chapter on Some Applications of Trigonometry. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Heights and Distances Problems Apply trigonometric ratios to find heights of towers, buildings, widths of rivers, etc. using angles of elevation/depression and known distances. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Draw the figure, identify right triangle, mark known/unknown sides
💡 Use tan θ = height/distance (most common ratio in these problems)
💡 Two-triangle problems: set up equations for each triangle, solve simultaneously
💡 Common setups: tower on cliff, observer moving closer/farther

try_this.hint: Start with the easier questions and work your way up. Use the key ideas above as a checklist.

fun_fact: Mathematics is the queen of sciences and some applications of trigonometry concepts like heights and distances problems are used in engineering, data science, and everyday problem solving!
